issues.title: Implement local login endpoint (POST /api/v1/auth/login)
issues.description: AuthService.LoginAsync — validate email/password, check lockout, increment failed_login_count on failure, reset on success, issue JWT + refresh token. JWT payload: user_id, role, department_id, exp. Returns 200 {success,data:{access_token,refresh_token,expires_in}} or 401/423. Rate-limit: 10 req/min per IP. FRs: FR-3, FR-4, FR-7. Tests: UT-1 to UT-5, IT-2.
acceptance_criteria: Returns 423 when lockout_until > now
Failed attempts increment counter
Successful login resets counter
Refresh token stored hashed

issues.title: Implement Azure AD SSO callback (GET /api/v1/auth/sso/callback)
issues.description: AuthService.SsoCallbackAsync — receive MSAL auth code, exchange for ID token via MSAL, upsert user from azure_ad_oid + email claims, issue JWT + refresh token. If user not found by OID, create with role=Employee. FRs: FR-1, FR-2. Tests: UT-6, IT-3.
acceptance_criteria: OID-first lookup before email
New users auto-created with Employee role
Returns same token envelope as local login

issues.title: Implement token refresh and logout endpoints
issues.description: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh — TokenService.IssueAccessToken from valid refresh token, rotate refresh token (revoke old, issue new). POST /api/v1/auth/logout — revoke refresh token. GET /api/v1/auth/me — return current user profile from JWT. FRs: FR-5, FR-6, FR-11. Tests: UT-7 to UT-10, IT-4, IT-5.
acceptance_criteria: Refresh rotates token (old revoked)
Logout marks refresh token revoked
Expired refresh token returns 401
